kill_fact: Attacks (a) and (b) fail cleanly - the event is real. The Agreement and Plan of Merger dated 23 November 2025, the fixed $8.11 cash plus 0.2215 New CommerceOne shares with no adjustment mechanism except stock splits/extraordinary distributions, the 23 November 2026 Termination Date extendable to 23 February 2027, the 72.2% pro forma ownership, the NYSE ticker CONE, the $27.0M / $3.5M / $40.0M fee stack and the 23 June 2026 vote (40,869,891 for / 139,918 against / 52,234 abstaining) all verify against the SEC primary record. Citi's $15.45-$17.51 verifies VERBATIM in the 16 June 2026 supplemental filing, and it already nets in the 72.2% ownership and the $8.11 cash, so the dossier's back-solve is redundant but not wrong. No Federal Reserve, Alabama or Utah approval has been announced through 27 July 2026 (the last transaction filing of any kind is the 24 June 2026 vote 8-K; company news since is operating items - Treasury Prime 25 June, Everest Group 27 July). The catalyst is LIVE, unfired, not formally slipped. The kill is attack (c): the floor breaks. The proxy contains a standalone valuation of Green Dot that the dossier never surfaces - Performance Trust (CommerceOne's advisor) valued Green Dot Common Stock standalone at $6.17-$8.09 on a terminal-TBV method and $9.03-$12.13 on a terminal-P/E method. The ENTIRE TBV branch sits below the $9.31 fifty-two-week low the dossier treats as its tail overshoot, and the P/E midpoint of $10.58 sits below the asserted $11.00 floor. The proxy also identifies the genuinely unaffected price as $7.46 on 7 March 2025, the last trading day before the strategic review was announced on 10 March 2025 (independently corroborated: the stock traded near $7.16 that week). The dossier concedes in its own text that the $11.80 of 21 November 2025 'already embedded eight months of public strategic-review optionality' and then anchors the floor on it anyway. Sixteen months of review-plus-deal optionality sits inside every anchor above $9.31, and a failed process extinguishes it. The honest broken-deal band is $8.50-$9.50 with a $7.46 tail, against tangible book of $10.08. That resets downside from $13.16 to roughly -28% to -36% (tail -43%), against upside contractually capped at $8.11 plus an unlistable, unhedgeable stub the market itself marks at $5.05. Risk/reward is roughly 0.25-0.35 to 1, not 0.5 to 1, and the residual risk is the SUCCESSFUL outcome. Attack (d) adds two omissions the 'nothing left but a rubber stamp' framing erases: closing is conditioned on no requisite regulatory approval producing a 'material burdensome condition' - a mutual walk-away triggered by precisely the one step that remains, on a bank under a live 19 July 2024 Federal Reserve consent order carrying a $44 million civil money penalty - and the $8.11 cash leg is funded by the Payments Sale proceeds, so it is structurally dependent on the Smith Ventures separation closing alongside the bank merger rather than on acquirer balance-sheet cash. Killed on the floor and the omitted conditionality, not on the event.
corrections: (1) LOAD-BEARING - downside_floor 11.0 must move to a 8.50-9.50 band with a 7.46 tail. Primary support: Performance Trust standalone DDM of Green Dot Common Stock at $6.17-$8.09 (terminal TBV method) and $9.03-$12.13 (terminal P/E method), disclosed in the 16 June 2026 supplemental filing; the proxy's own unaffected price of $7.46 on 7 March 2025, the last trading day before the 10 March 2025 strategic-review announcement; tangible book of $10.08 per share ($940.5M equity less $369.0M intangibles = $571.5M over 56,682,705 shares, Q1 2026 10-Q). The dossier's three-anchor bracket ($10.03 TBV / $11.80 undisturbed / $9.31 low) silently excludes both the buyer-advisor's standalone work and the $7.46 print it quotes elsewhere in its own text. Consequently the stated re-entry levels are too high: $12.60 and $12.15 do not restore two-to-one against a $9.00 floor; that entry is nearer $11.00-$11.50. (2) LOAD-BEARING - the $14.23-$19.18 range is NOT 'management's own illustrative range' given by the chief financial officer on the 24 November 2025 call. The dossier asserts this three times (sop_bull, consensus_delta, section 6) and builds its 'category error' argument on it. The proxy attributes the range to CITI's Selected Public Companies Analysis of the Combined Company ($491M-$889M implied equity value, at 72.2% ownership plus $8.11 cash), stated as a 21%-63% premium to $11.80 on 21 November 2025 and a 91%-157% premium to $7.46 on 7 March 2025. The numbers are right; the attribution is wrong, so the rhetorical point about the sponsor quoting its own floor collapses. (3) LOAD-BEARING - the operating fact is a year stale. 'June-quarter earnings of $0.40 a share against a $0.30 estimate' (valley_of_death, section 4) cannot be the June 2026 quarter: Green Dot has not reported it as of 28 July 2026 (it reports in early-to-mid August; Q2 2025 was 11 August 2025). $0.40 is the Q2 2025 print. The actual most recent quarter is Q1 2026, reported 11 May 2026: revenue $656.2M +17% y/y, GAAP diluted EPS $0.93 vs $0.47, non-GAAP $1.12 vs $0.88 consensus, GAAP net income $53.8M vs $25.8M. The direction of the claim survives and is in fact understated, but the cited fact is not current and must not stand in a dated dossier. (4) The stub-mispricing centerpiece is one-sided. The dossier headlines the market's implied $22.80 per New CommerceOne share as '32% below the low end of the banker's own valuation', citing only Citi's $33.6-$43.0. Performance Trust marked the same 0.2215 stock leg at an implied Green Dot per-share purchase price of $5.98, implying roughly $27 per New CommerceOne share - the market's $5.05 is about 16% below THAT mark, not 32% below a consensus. Two advisors disagree by more than 50% on the stub; the dossier reports only the higher one. (5) Citi's dividend-discount parameters are misstated. Per the supplemental disclosure Citi applied a perpetuity growth rate of 2.0%-3.0% and a discount range of 11.00%-12.00%, not '2.5% perpetuity growth against a 12.63% discount rate'. Footnote-level; the $590M-$755M output is correct. (6) Scale/attribution: the $6.65bn is Green Dot CORPORATION consolidated total assets at 31 March 2026 per the Q1 2026 10-Q, not Green Dot Bank standalone as stated. CommerceOne had approximately $837M total assets at 31 December 2025 (the dossier's '$892 million as of March 2026' is a different date/source); the acquirer/target ratio near 1:8 sharpens rather than softens the regulatory risk already flagged. (7) Minor: 56,682,705 shares outstanding, not 'roughly 57.0 million'; tangible book $10.08, not $10.03; the Payments Buyer of record is Green Dot OpCo, LLC, an affiliate of Smith Ventures, LLC. (8) CONFIRMED, not corrected: the 19 July 2024 Federal Reserve consent order and its $44 million civil money penalty (8-K gdot-20240719, paid July 2024, covering consumer-compliance UDAP in prepaid card marketing/servicing and AML risk management); and the -7.7% trailing ROE - FY2025 net loss of $98.9M on $2.1bn revenue less Q1 2025 (+$25.8M) plus Q1 2026 (+$53.8M) gives a TTM loss near -$71M on $940.5M equity, about -7.5%. Note the run-rate is now positive, so 'loss-making' is a TTM artifact dominated by 2025. (9) Fairness counterweight, recorded and rejected: Citi's STANDALONE Green Dot DDM gives $13.15-$16.30, which would argue the floor is HIGHER than $11.00. It is built on management projections and cannot be reconciled with a $7.46 unaffected print, a TTM loss, and a negative earnings yield. Where the advisors conflict, the observable unaffected market prints side with Performance Trust. (10) The dossier's own conclusion - verdict B, do not add here, wait for the price not the news - is directionally correct and honestly argued. The kill is that once the floor is set from the primary record, the position is worse than the file says, not merely uncompensated.
evidence: Green Dot Corp Form 8-K, event 23 June 2026, filed 24 June 2026 (CIK 0001386278, accession 0001140361-26-026125), Items 5.07 and 8.01: special meetings held 23 June 2026; merger proposal 40,869,891 for / 139,918 against / 52,234 abstaining, more than 99% of votes cast and approximately 72% of the 56,682,705 Class A shares outstanding at the 15 May 2026 record date; CommerceOne holders 100% in favour, approximately 69% of outstanding. 'Green Dot and CommerceOne expect the Proposed Transaction to be completed in the third quarter of 2026, subject to receipt of required regulatory approvals' from the Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, the Alabama State Banking Department and the Utah Department of Financial Institutions. Verified 28 July 2026: no approval order or completion announcement has followed - the catalyst is live, unfired and shareholder-cleared. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1386278/000114036126026125/ef20076604_ex99-1.htm

Green Dot Corp Form 425 supplemental merger disclosures, filed 16 June 2026 (accession 0001140361-26-025338), issued in response to the Phillips / Richardson / Zaccagnino disclosure suits: confirms Citi's combined-company dividend-discount analysis at an implied equity value of $590 million to $755 million using a perpetuity growth rate of 2.0%-3.0% and discount rates of 11.00%-12.00%, which 'accounting for the approximate 72.2% ownership in the Combined Company by Green Dot stockholders ... and the $8.11 of per share cash consideration' indicates $15.45 to $17.51 per Green Dot share - the bull target verifies verbatim. THE KILL: the same filing discloses that Performance Trust 'performed a standalone analysis that estimated the net present value of potential dividends that could be distributed to holders of Green Dot Common Stock ... indicated a range of per share values of Green Dot Common Stock of $6.17 to $8.09 based on TBV multiple terminal value methodology and $9.03 to $12.13 based on P/E multiple terminal value methodology', a primary-source standalone valuation lying largely or wholly BELOW the asserted $11.00 floor. Citi's standalone Green Dot DDM of $13.15-$16.30 is recorded as counterweight. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1386278/000114036126025338/ef20076171_425.htm

Green Dot Corp DEFM14A / 424B3 definitive proxy statement-prospectus, filed May 2026 (accession 0001140361-26-020056; prospectus 0001140361-26-020044): consideration fixed at 0.2215 New CommerceOne shares plus $8.11 in cash per Green Dot share, 'without interest and subject to any required tax withholding', the exchange ratio not adjusting except for stock splits or extraordinary distributions - no financing condition, no collar, no cash election, no CVR. Termination Date 23 November 2026, extendable to 23 February 2027. Termination fees $27.0M (Green Dot to CommerceOne), $3.5M reverse, $40.0M from Payments Buyer under the Separation Agreement. Former Green Dot stockholders to own approximately 72.2% of New CommerceOne, which intends to list on the NYSE under 'CONE'. Required approvals: Federal Reserve Board, Alabama State Banking Department, Utah Department of Financial Institutions, HSR. Decisive for the floor: Citi's Selected Public Companies Analysis range of $14.23-$19.18 is expressly CITI's, not management's, and is stated as 'a 21% to 63% premium to the price per share of Green Dot Class A Common Stock of $11.80 on November 21, 2025 ... and a 91% to 157% premium to the price per share of Green Dot Class A Common Stock of $7.46 on March 7, 2025, the last trading day prior to the public announcement of the Green Dot Board's strategic review process.' Closing is conditioned on no requisite regulatory approval having resulted in a 'material burdensome condition'; the Per Share Cash Consideration 'will be funded by the Payments Sale'. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001386278/000114036126020056/ny20062448x1_defm14a.htm

Green Dot Corp Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 31 March 2026, filed 11 May 2026 (accession 0001386278-26-000035), read with the 11 May 2026 Q1 2026 earnings release and the 19 July 2024 Form 8-K (gdot-20240719): total stockholders' equity $940.5M (up from $890.2M at year-end 2025), intangibles $369.0M, tangible value $571.5M = $10.08 per share on 56,682,705 shares; total assets $6.65bn (Green Dot Corporation consolidated, not the Bank standalone). Q1 2026 revenue $656.2M +17% y/y, GAAP diluted EPS $0.93 vs $0.47, GAAP net income $53.8M - this, not a $0.40 June quarter, is the most recent reported period as of 28 July 2026. FY2025 was a $98.9M net loss on $2.1bn revenue, giving a TTM ROE near -7.5% and confirming the break case rests on asset value rather than earnings power. The 19 July 2024 8-K confirms the Federal Reserve consent order against Green Dot Corporation and Green Dot Bank and its $44 million civil money penalty, paid July 2024, covering consumer-compliance UDAP in prepaid card marketing, selling and servicing and anti-money-laundering risk management - the live enforcement backdrop to the one approval that remains. https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001386278/000138627826000035/gdot-20260331.htm
